# Vendored Front-End Asset Manifest
#
# This file is the authoritative pin for every third-party asset under
# app/static/vendor/.  Bumping a version requires (a) replacing the file,
# (b) recomputing its SHA-384 below, and (c) verifying the page renders
# correctly with the new asset.  See docs/runbook/4_security_operations.md "CDN vendor refresh
# procedure" for the full process.
#
# These assets were vendored as part of remediation Commit C-02 (audit
# 2026-04-15) to retire the CDN dependencies named in F-037.  The CSP
# Phase-1 hardening drops external origins from script-src / style-src
# / font-src; with the assets self-hosted, every front-end resource
# ships from this repo.
#
# Format per line: <relative path> | <upstream URL> | sha384-<base64 hash>
# Hashes computed via (the value is BASE64, not hex; the manifest test
# tests/test_adversarial/test_cache_control.py::test_vendor_manifest_matches_the_bytes_served
# recomputes every line):
#   openssl dgst -sha384 -binary <file> | openssl base64 -A

# ── zxcvbn 4.4.2 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Distribution: https://github.com/dropbox/zxcvbn (archived but stable)
# License: MIT (https://github.com/dropbox/zxcvbn/blob/master/LICENSE.txt)
# Used by app/static/js/password_strength.js to score the password
# strength meter on the registration and change-password forms.  See
# audit finding F-089 / commit C-11 of the 2026-04-15 security
# remediation plan.  The script falls back to a no-op when this asset
# is missing, so a deferred refresh does not break the form -- but
# without it the meter cannot render and users lose the strength
# feedback.
zxcvbn/zxcvbn.js                       | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/zxcvbn@4.4.2/dist/zxcvbn.js                          | sha384-LXuP8lknSGBOLVn4fwVOl+rWR+zOEtZx6CF9ZLaN6gKBgLByU4D79VWWjV4/gefq
